name: porkbun
description: A Pulumi provider for Porkbun: DNS records and domain nameservers.

nodejs.packageDescription: A Pulumi provider for Porkbun: DNS records and domain nameservers.

apiKey.description: Porkbun API key (`pk1_…`). Can also be set with the `PORKBUN_API_KEY` environment variable.

baseUrl.description: Override the Porkbun API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.porkbun.com/api/json/v3`; only useful for testing.

secretApiKey.description: Porkbun secret API key (`sk1_…`). Can also be set with the `PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY` environment variable.

name.description: The subdomain, empty for the apex.

notes.description: The note stored with the record, if any.

prio.description: Priority; 0 for types that have none.

recordId.description: Porkbun's ID for the record. Import it as `<domain>/<recordId>`.

content.description: The record's value. For `TXT`, give the text without surrounding quotes.

domain.description: The domain the record belongs to, e.g. `example.com`. Changing it replaces the record.

fqdn.description: The record's fully qualified name, e.g. `www.example.com`.

name.description: The subdomain, without the domain: `www`, `*` for a wildcard, or empty (the default) for the apex.

notes.description: A note stored with the record in Porkbun. It is not published in DNS.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. Porkbun's minimum is 600, which is also the default.

porkbun:index:getDnsRecords.description: Lists every editable DNS record on a Porkbun domain. Porkbun's default NS and SOA records are not included. Useful for finding record IDs to import.

porkbun:index:getNameservers.description: Returns the nameservers a Porkbun-registered domain is delegated to.

nameservers.description: The domain's nameservers, as the registry has them.
